effect_mechanism: Pooled costs are the up-front investment in floodwater-diversion systems: compiler-reported establishment costs per hectare from WOCAT sheets for Tunisia and Jordan (the Jordan sheet's total spread over 10 ha), and the average investment cost of spate systems under a World Bank project in Yemen, reported at USD 800-1200 per hectare with farmers contributing a 15-20% share.

The cost class rests on the Tunisian sheet alone, because the Yemen completion-report range has no single value and the Jordan sheet is an upper-middle-income case; the Yemen report itself calls the farmer contribution comparatively high, and none of these is a cost per hectare restored.
